author: jochembrouwer
content:
Hi <@1361003005691822160> and <@261161007982968833>, what is the status here? I see https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12370 is still in draft. I think we should also discuss how we handle the case if the account actually gets created, via the TCREATE opcode where we send value or if we CREATE[2] from the TCREATEd contract.

In case of TCREATE sending value it it clear to me that we should charge the account creation costs. Now the nasty part is where at the end of the transaction all funds have moved out of this account again (so this is now an empty account). If the account did not exist before the transaction we should (?) refund (?) the account creation costs.
In case of TCREATEd contract using CREATE, we charge extra costs on CREATE: if the account would now get (permanently) created, we charge the extra account creation costs
